title: Course-level training administration and delivery
decision_reason: Retained sources support a bounded validation question; complete operational/financial records, accountable owner confirmation and applicable authority are absent.
current_arrangement: Retained DPPA and DPO planned training totals describe different mandates and measures. Public course notices and completion evidence have incomplete delivery populations; the retained course watch is paused.
testable_mechanism: At unique course-run and participant/cohort level, test whether separately funded administrative, procurement, platform or logistics tasks are substitutable while specialist content and training outcomes remain necessary.
feasible_alternative_to_test: Share a specific administrative or procurement service where course-run evidence shows repeated avoidable work; retain distinct specialist instruction and necessary security or pedagogic controls.
safeguards: Protect specialist military, police, civilian, language and accessibility requirements
Preserve delivery quality, competency outcomes and operational readiness
Do not treat scheduled events as delivered courses or duplicate participants as duplicate expenditure
Keep the course watch paused; no new monitoring or course delivery verification is authorized by this dossier
cost_perimeter_and_nonadditivity: Training days, participant-days, courses and staff effort are different denominators. Include instructors, participant duty time, travel, platforms, facilities, procurement, administration and transition costs across funds. Embedded reductions are baseline; overlapping subjects alone justify no financial estimate.
minimum_records: Unique course-run ID, delivery dates/status, provider, curriculum/version, intended capability and prerequisites
Restricted participant/cohort IDs, completion and assessment results with safe public aggregates
Actual contracts, invoices, travel, platform/facility costs, instructor and administrative time by course-run
Current procurement/administrative process map, controls, retained obligations and owner-approved comparator
custodian_roles_to_confirm: DPPA and DPO training programme owners
Course provider and training procurement/finance custodians

case_specific_limit: No course cancellation, duplicate-delivery finding, participant productivity estimate or automatic watch restart follows from planned totals.
handling: No identifiable payroll, participant, medical, security, live transaction or restricted clearance records in this public dossier; use authorized restricted intake and approved safe derivatives.
reopen_condition: Confirm owner and authority, obtain authenticated complete linked records, define comparator and guardrails, and adjudicate validation-ready evidence. A prepared request or software pass is insufficient.
